mentions.name: Flopper
mentions.description: This platform aggregates a holistic view of the GPU market, including providers, rental prices, vendor information, and GPU specs. It also offers a calculator that uses power/flops and model requirements to estimate how many GPUs are needed to run a given model, configurable by model, precision, context, concurrency, tokens/sec, output length, and cache.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still plugging away on Flopper to build a holistic view of the GPU market including providers, rental prices, vendor information and mostly - specs for GPUs.

Added a way to look at power/flops and new model requirements lately to try and estimate how many GPUs you need to run a certain model
